description: This file contains the implementation of Smarty internal compilation classes for handling 'if', 'elseif', 'else', and closing 'if' tags within Smarty templates. It provides methods to compile these template constructs into PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_If
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {if} Smarty template tag into PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Else
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {else} Smarty template tag into PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Elseif
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {elseif} Smarty template tag into PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Ifclose
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling the {/if} Smarty template closing tag into PHP code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {if} tag into PHP code based on provided arguments and parameters.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {else} tag into PHP code, closing previous blocks and opening an else block.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {elseif} tag into PHP code, handling else-if logic within the template.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {/if} closing tag into PHP, closing all nested if blocks.
